mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.0% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 9.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO above 1.5% YoY) indicates capacity utilization and profit margin expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction activity (HOUST) reflects strong housing market fundamentals and household confidence, consistently leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates robust labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-2008 recovery regime, a stable federal funds rate (below 0.5%) supports continued economic expansion and equity market gains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime is below 0.05.
